title: Arc Microgrants: Built with Arc Studio
description: The second round of Arc Microgrants backs experiments built with Arc Studio, Arc's onchain coding agent: start in Arc Studio and finish with something live on Arc mainnet that moves real USDC. Eight microgrants of $500 USDC each, from a $4,000 USDC pool. Submissions close November 1, 2026 and are reviewed as they come in.
reward: $500 USDC per microgrant (8 microgrants, $4,000 USDC pool)

rules: Submissions open October 15, 2026 and close November 1, 2026 (DoraHacks: Nov 2, 10:29 AM IST, which is Nov 1, 11:59 PM ET). Reviewed as they come in; earlier submissions get earlier answers.

Your project must be built in Arc Studio and deployed to Arc mainnet at the time you submit: contracts written and tested in Arc Studio, a working app built in Arc Studio live at a public link, and at least one Arc mainnet transaction that moves USDC through your contract and app.
Not eligible: projects built outside Arc Studio, testnet-only builds, design mockups, slide decks, and work already funded by a Circle or Arc program.
Projects submitted to the first Arc Microgrants round can enter if they were built in Arc Studio and meet these requirements. A project can receive only one microgrant.
One submission per project. Teams can submit more than one distinct project.
Open to individuals and teams worldwide, subject to sanctions and restricted-jurisdiction screening. Pseudonymous builders can submit; verification happens only after conditional selection.
Microgrants are paid in USDC on Arc. You need a wallet that can receive USDC on Arc.
You keep full ownership of your work. No equity, no IP assignment, no exclusivity.
Program dates and microgrant counts may be adjusted.
